settings.grammar: B[dst] = a*B[src]^2 + b*B[add] + c*I on 2 or 3 FP16 buffers; src = previous dst
settings.first_row: pure: R^2; semi: R^2 + b R (one elementwise pass); general: + c I (two passes)
settings.score: exact-arithmetic sqrt(mean((f(sigma/sigma_hat) - 1)^2)) per harvested matrix, sigma_hat = u_safe * runtime FP16 bound; the polish used this score
settings.anchors: PS3_55 segments seed the 5-squaring families (zhehangdu/polar-switch, MIT)

latency_sanity.clock: CUDA events (gpu) and synchronized host clock (wall), L2 flushed, random order
